The '''Promised Ones''' were the descendants of a group of [[Outcasts (Taris)|Outcasts]] living in the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. They gave themselves this name after reaching the [[Promised Land]] and also after the rest of the planet's population was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire's]] [[Destruction of Taris|bombardment]] of the planet. Eventually the group died off completely due to [[rakghoul]]s, [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] sickness and starvation.<ref name="TOR" />

The group had individuals who served as the [[keeper of memories]], whose responsibility it was to keep a record of their experiences. Keepers for the Promised Ones included [[Rukil]], [[Baral]], [[Ku-ki]] and [[Lurr (individual)|Lurr]].<ref name="TOR" />
